items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: People have said I sound like Billie Holiday, I sound like Mildred Bailey... And Stan made the point that Mildred (Bailey) had never made a record at that point... So it's not impossible that some people have a little bit of the same kind of feel as another person

ctx.x: Was members of his family, were they all long lived people? Did they have long lives?
Well, I didn't know too much about them. I knew I had a cousin. Her name was Mildred. And then I had an Uncle Ed. But they all died, you know, they died when I was young.
